title: 2026 Minnesota Sentencing Guidelines — Medical Assistance Fraud offense rankings
supports: The 2026 adopted modifications rank Medical Assistance Fraud involving $100,000 or less at Severity Level 2.
The 2026 adopted modifications rank Medical Assistance Fraud involving $100,001 through $1,000,000 at Severity Level 6.
The 2026 adopted modifications rank Medical Assistance Fraud involving more than $1,000,000 at Severity Level 8.
The 2026 Guidelines are effective for felony offenses committed on or after August 1, 2026, subject to applicable sentencing law.
does_not_support: Severity Level 8 does not by itself state the sentence in an individual case; criminal-history score, grid rules, departures and other sentencing law remain relevant.
The guideline ranking should not be retroactively assigned to pre-effective-date conduct without legal analysis.
notes: For public explanation, cite the actual offense ranking and grid rather than paraphrasing only the Attorney General's Aug. 3 press release.
